summary: CervoMed Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 7.01, 8.01, 9.01) on April 22, 2026, disclosing press release and presentation about Phase 2b RewinD-LB trial data for neflamapimod in dementia with Lewy bodies, presented at the 2026 AAN Annual Meeting. The filing is a routine clinical update, with no special-situation event, deal terms, premium, or advisor. No structural or risk-arb considerations apply. This is a standard disclosure of trial results, not a special situation.
